source_name: RS Business Register — Jedinstveni informacioni sistem (bizreg.esrpska.com)
rate_limits: free per-company query (POST term=Naziv/JIB/MBS); no open bulk
notes: Republika Srpska business register. POST /Home/SearchPoslovniSubjekt with single term= returns JSON: JIB (13-digit), MBS, MB, name, address, primary activity, status, founders (Osnivači — PERSONAL DATA if individuals, redact), contacts. Per-company PDF official extract /Home/DetaljiPoslovnogSubjekta/{id}. Verified live: Nova banka JIB 4400374890002, RiTE Gacko 4401387900003, B2 LINK 4402978800004. No open bulk/API key. RS entities only.

organization: High Judicial and Prosecutorial Council (VSTV/HJPC) — entity courts
rate_limits: per-company APEX search (Naziv / JIB / MBS); session-bound; no open bulk/API
notes: Central court business-register portal for the Federation of BiH and Brčko District (Oracle APEX, app 183). Per-company search by name/JIB/MBS; no open JSON/bulk export. Covers entities not in the RS system. Catalogued from the public portal.

source_name: APIF — Registar finansijskih izvještaja (RFI) + Registar boniteta
organization: APIF — Agencija za posredničke, informatičke i finansijske usluge (Republika Srpska)
rate_limits: per-company report for a fee (naknada in KM); no open bulk
notes: RS register of annual financial statements (balance sheet / income statement) for all RS legal entities; plus a creditworthiness (bonitet) register. Reports priced per company (KM). No open bulk. Currency BAM. Catalogued from public APIF docs; no raw values copied.

rate_limits: per-company report / bonitet for a fee; no open bulk
notes: FBiH register of annual financial statements (the FIA counterpart to APIF RFI). Per-company paid reports / bonitet; no open bulk. Currency BAM. Catalogued from public docs.

source_name: UINO — Indirect Taxation Authority (JIB / PDV VAT)
notes: State-level indirect tax authority. Administers the single VAT (PDV) and assigns the 12-digit PDV broj (VAT number, separate from the JIB) for VAT-registered entities. Per-company taxpayer verification; no open bulk. JIB is the company/tax id; PDV broj is the VAT id.
